description: Validerer product_audit + trigger efter prisændring på Espresso.

assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'product_audit'

SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = 'products' AND t.tgname = 'trg_product_price' AND NOT t.tgisinternal
SELECT price FROM products WHERE name = 'Espresso'
SELECT old_price, new_price FROM product_audit a JOIN products p ON p.id = a.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Espresso' ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1
